decision: approved architecture 2026-09-24: two dedicated Deno Deploy apps + one separate Supabase project (Arma2 Torneos) for data only
platform: Deno Deploy (Deno 2.x runtime; npm: specifiers; outbound TCP/HTTPS)

torneos-gateway.forbiddenEnforcement: runtime: commerce TEST refuses to boot on any MERCADO_PAGO_* / payments DB / provider / notification / lab variable (commerce.ts FORBIDDEN_GATEWAY_ENV)
torneos-gateway.forbiddenPlatformOnlyNote: never read by gateway code (static guard); not boot-refused by the gateway runtime in R3 — guaranteed by app-level variables + no database integration (pending platform check)

dbLogins: <dedicated payments login>, NOINHERIT member of torneos_payment_service
torneos-payments.forbiddenPattern: ^PG[A-Z_]+$ (every PG* variable: postgres.js 3.4.7 reads PGHOST/PGUSER/PGPASSWORD/PGDATABASE/… and PG<OPTION>; PostgREST PGRST_* secrets)
torneos-payments.forbiddenEnforcement: runtime: config.ts FORBIDDEN_PAYMENTS_ENV + FORBIDDEN_PAYMENTS_ENV_RE — any non-blank value refuses the boot (503 on both routes, no DB connection)
torneos-payments.forbiddenDbLoginsEnforcement: runtime: the login part of TORNEOS_PAYMENTS_DB_URL (pooler `<login>.<ref>`, %-decoded, case-insensitive) — independent of variable names

sharedBetweenApps: TORNEOS_PAYMENTS_INTERNAL_SECRET (gateway→payments HMAC; distinct from every other secret)
invariants: gateway and payments are two different Deno Deploy apps with disjoint secret sets (only the internal HMAC key is shared)
every sensitive variable is set at APP level; organization-level environment variables are forbidden (they are inherited by every app of the organization)
no Deno Deploy database integration / linked database on either app (it would inject DATABASE_URL / PG* into a runtime); connections keep the dedicated least-privilege logins
the Torneos Supabase project hosts no Edge Function (every function there would receive SUPABASE_DB_URL and the service role)
remote-test requires https and the exact declared hosts; hosts are never hard-coded
webhook ts authenticates only; ordering uses only the re-fetched provider date_last_updated
pendingRemotePlatformChecks: create exactly two Deno Deploy apps (torneos-gateway, torneos-payments) and confirm each has its own variable set
list organization-level environment variables and confirm there are none
confirm no database / Postgres integration is linked to either app and that neither runtime receives DATABASE_URL or PG* (payments would refuse to boot; the gateway relies on this check)
confirm sensitive variables are marked secret and are not exposed to build steps or to preview / branch deployments beyond intent

configure each app with root backend/torneos/supabase/functions so the repo-root package.json is outside Deno's resolution scope (otherwise npm: imports fail closed at boot); verify both entrypoints boot on the platform's current Deno 2.x
bind the declared TORNEOS_COMMERCE_REMOTE_GATEWAY_HOST / _PAYMENTS_HOST to the real app domains over HTTPS and confirm the gateway Host check and the exact payments URL match
review organization membership (every member is an owner) and restrict it to the operators of this deployment
observe a real Mercado Pago TEST notification end to end (ts length 10 or 13, signature accepted, provider re-fetch, ordering by date_last_updated)
